accessDenied.title: No staff access
accessDenied.reason: Only the owner or an admin can manage the team at {branch}.

title: Staff
summary: {count, plural, one {# person works} other {# people work}} at {branch}

empty.title: No staff yet
empty.description: Invite cashiers, kitchen staff and managers to share access to the dashboard, POS and KDS.

admin.label: Admin
admin.description: Everything you can do, except billing and adding another admin. For a business partner or general manager.

manager.label: Manager
manager.description: Runs the day to day: orders, refunds, menu, stock, promos, drivers, reports and staff hours. No billing, branding or staff invites.

cashier.label: Cashier
cashier.description: Counter and payments. Takes orders and money, applies discounts, reprints receipts, cancels before payment. Refunds need a manager.

server.label: Server
server.description: Dine-in only. Builds a table order, sends it to the kitchen and watches its progress. Sees only their own orders — no takings, no reports.

kitchen.label: Kitchen
kitchen.description: The kitchen display only. Accept, cooking, ready, plus marking items low or sold out. No customer or payment details.

driver.label: Driver
driver.description: Appears in your staff list but has no back-office access at all — riders work in the Driver app, where they see only their own jobs and earnings.

staff.label: Staff (general)
staff.description: Counter access only. The original catch-all role, kept for existing team members.
